error[ZBX-E0524]: the image has no command to run
  while  choosing what 'registry.test/fixture/open:3.20' runs
  cause  the image sets no entrypoint and no command, and none was given
  image  registry.test/fixture/open:3.20
  fix    say what to run:   zbx run 'registry.test/fixture/open:3.20' -- <command> [arguments]
  more   zbx explain E0524
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0524.html
